svg.title: MSCA-Dilated spatial and channel gates
svg.desc: The upper lane compares the three sampling footprints for dilation 1, 2 and 4. Their concatenated features are projected and scored by the energy gate. The lower lane uses global average pooling, two pointwise projections and sigmoid to make one weight per channel, with a 1024 to 128 to 1024 bottleneck. The middle line carries the original F, and the product applies both gate weights to it.
svg.metadata: Revision 44, Figure 5. Scientific source: MSCA_Dilated.py and equations (2)–(5) of revision 44. Layout reference: LoftUp, ICCV 2025, Fig. 3, for isolating the grid sampling positions. Native SVG drawing. Monochrome composition proof.
